codex_read_only_source_review.scope: Path admission, not correctness or performance certification
findings: Reviewed full source and final diff against reviewed round-06 parent; generic kernel and non-fp16 arithmetic unchanged.
New helper uses Triton bitcasts, shifts and OR to pack two rounded fp16 values into one int32 store; all value computation remains Triton.
Host allocates contiguous int32 output and reinterprets dtype with Tensor.view(dtype); this aliases storage and changes metadata, not device computation.
Packed row offsets account for output-word units, two output rows per input row and plane offsets. OW equals twice IW on selected path; tail and row masks bound writes.
FP16 dispatch depends on dtype and exact scale metadata, not test identity or values. Existing row-tile heuristic is metadata based.
Little-endian packing and dtype-view runtime admission require actual preflight; no claim of numerical or compilation success before testing.
